''See also: [[Estyr Six Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr]] Six is a legendary figure in [[Imperial]] history, known as one of the Emperor's three surviving companions and a founding member of [[The Empire|the Empire]]. Originally born [[Estyr Fourteen]], she took her current name after her family was killed by the [[Worm Lord]], [[Kthanikahr]]. She is a [[Soulbound]], a class of elite warriors possessing immense power derived from the pinnacle of [[Reading]]. Her abilities include flight and the use of three [[Sandborn Hydra|Hydra]] skulls that orbit her head as a macabre halo. Throughout history, she has served in various high-ranking capacities, including as the [[Imperial Steward]] of the [[Aurelian Empire]] and an interim Head of the [[Imperial Guard]]. In her role with the Guard, she enforced the security of original prisons designed by [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]], utilizing a device to detect [[Readers]] attempting to enter or exit these facilities. As a [[Regent]], she is regarded as a legendary protector of [[The Empire|the Empire]], though some suggest she lacks the desire to rule. Her life and philosophies are documented in her personal journals, which contain various historical observations and maxims.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|A hero of the early Empire, [[Estyr]] Six served as an interim Head of the [[Imperial Guard]] and kept a journal that made mention of prisons. During her service, she fought alongside the Emperor to defeat [[Nakothi]] and later provided testimony concerning the [[Handmaidens of Nakothi]]. Her legendary exploits include flying over the ranks of a thousand [[Elderspawn]], and she remains a potential [[Empress]] of the [[Aurelian Empire]].}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Born as [[Estyr Fourteen]], the ruler known as [[Estyr]] Six possesses [[Vessels]] capable of experiencing intense rage and fury. Although poets and historians have documented the accomplishments of the [[Estyr]] Six for many generations, the ruler themselves lacks the necessary will to govern. [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] has noted specific qualities in the manner in which people address the monarch. Furthermore, [[Estyr]] Six last spoke five hundred years ago.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Estyr Six]] was born [[Estyr Fourteen]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Estyr Six]]'s [[Vessels]] can feel rage and fury.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c1" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin]] compares the way people speak to [[Estyr Six]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c2">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|The accomplishments of the [[Estyr Six]] have been written about by poets and historians for generations.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c4">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>

</ul></div>

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A statuesque woman with long blonde hair, the [[Regent]] [[Estyr]] Six is a member of the first generation of [[Readers]] and is bound by an ancient arrangement to the Emperor's will. As the strongest [[Soulbound]] in history, she is accompanied by three floating [[Sandborn Hydra|Hydra]] skulls known as [[Vessels]] and possesses a high weight of [[Intent]]. She maintains her [[Authority|authority]] through the belief that leadership requires giving orders, and she can use an invisible hand to seize a person's throat. During her conflicts against [[General Teach]] and [[Baldezar Kern]], she accused [[Calder]] of collaborating with [[Elders]], though she possesses the power to find and kill him even if he hides in a bunker.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A historical figure and the [[Regent]] of the North, [[Estyr]] Six served as the Emperor's partner in rebellion. Known as an unstoppable one-woman army, she utilized massive [[Iron|iron]] spikes and the power of hydra skulls to stay aloft, often accompanied by three circling skulls. During her exploits, she crashed through the northern wall of a top floor and was later seen flying in armor over [[Candle Bay]], where she caused a pile of ship wood to levitate. Though she was a girlhood hero to [[Jarelys Teach]], her legacy remains complex, as [[Shera]] compared the judgment of her group to that of [[Meia]]. Throughout various accounts, she is noted as a person whose victory relied on obtaining skulls and one whom [[Cheska Bennett]] attempted to stop.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">15</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr Six]] is a person for whom victory depends on obtaining skulls.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr Six]] crashed through the northern wall of the top floor.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr Six]] is the [[Regent]] of the North.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Estyr Six]] is a group whose judgment [[Shera]] compares to [[Meia]]'s.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref>}}</li>
